d:
A mother and son argue.
A teenage boy rides with his mother to a piano recital. It's an important performance, and he's listening to music, trying to visualize his playing as he sits in the backseat. His mother is talking on speakerphone in the car.
When his mother tries to engage, he tells her he needs to concentrate. He goes back to listening to the music, but they get into an argument. It escalates into something much uglier than a squabble, illuminating the vast gulf between them.
